method: Manual browser interaction in the in-app browser
scope: Workflow checks used an isolated SQLite database and a server that rejected external HTTP requests. Claim-review input was explicitly labelled as a UI fixture. Real GPT checks below replayed previously saved answers in the main workspace; no model was called from the browser during these checks.

checks.name: Create remediation task
checks.observed: Task includes both affected occurrences and the advisory fixed-version boundary.

checks.name: Persist task edits
checks.observed: Owner, processing status and note saved with an audit entry.

checks.name: Partial fix verification
checks.observed: demo-partial leaves one target occurrence and records needs_review.

checks.name: Complete inventory verification
checks.observed: demo-resolved leaves zero target occurrences; UI explicitly excludes business-test and deployment approval.

checks.name: Task download
checks.observed: The task JSON download completed through the browser.

checks.name: Concurrent tab conflict
checks.observed: A stale second-tab save was rejected. Refresh preserved the first tab's saved owner.

checks.name: Snapshot isolation
checks.observed: Switching to demo-partial replaced old task cards with the current snapshot loading state; public input had no demo task cards.

checks.name: Separate literal and semantic review
checks.observed: Exact text match displayed separately from initially pending human review.

checks.name: Human review persistence
checks.observed: A partial-support note on the labelled UI fixture persisted after snapshot switching and answer replay.

checks.name: Usage policy
checks.observed: Isolated policy saved as five requests and USD 0.05 per UTC day; request count remained zero.

checks.name: Public lockfile import
checks.observed: Original Datatracker lockfile imported through the file chooser: 571 component occurrences, 570 unqueried positions, explicit incomplete coverage.

checks.name: Large quality list
checks.observed: 591 entries showed eight initially; expanding exposed the final entry and collapsing hid the remainder while retaining coverage warnings.

checks.name: Actual GPT answer replay
checks.observed: Saved 2026-11-11 GPT answer displayed its two paths, original token usage and pending human-review controls without regeneration.

checks.name: Actual usage display
checks.observed: Main workspace showed three calls, USD 0.021287 estimated/reserved occupancy and three calls with incomplete pricing; no zero-cost assertion.

checks.name: Responsive layout and console
checks.observed: 390px viewport had no horizontal document overflow; main and isolated pages had no captured console errors. Viewport override was reset.

limitations: This is a manual UI acceptance record, not an automated browser test suite or a semantic accuracy score.
Public input import does not establish vulnerability coverage, runtime exploitability or successful business remediation.
Only existing paid responses were replayed; live-model-status.json records the separate three-request real-model acceptance run.
